My Story

Who I
Am

Cinematic Video
AI · UGC
Lagos, NG

I'm Teniola Sogbetun, a cinematic video creator and AI content specialist based in Lagos, Nigeria — known online as 10CTY.

My work sits at the intersection of face-to-camera authenticity and cutting-edge AI video generation. I build content around genuine storytelling and relatability — breaking down complex Web3 protocols, AI tools, and fintech platforms into stories that actually connect with people.

I developed the Triple Layer format: a production system that combines live face-cam footage, AI-generated visual sequences, and motion design overlays into a single cohesive cinematic piece. It's what makes my content feel different from standard UGC.

I have produced proof-of-work content for brands across Web3, Web2, and the AI space.

Beyond content — I hold a Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry from Lagos State University, and I bring technical range that most creators don't: HTML, CSS, graphic design, and sound production. I've always been someone who solves problems, and that shows in every piece of content I make. I take complex ideas and translate them into something simple, relatable, and human.

I also work as a Prompt Engineer, an AI Automation Specialist at an intermediate level, and a Brand Consultant — helping brands think clearly about how they show up, what they say, and how technology can make it more efficient.
